professionalSummary: Product manager with four years leading the integrations area of a developer analytics suite, responsible for writing product requirements, conducting discovery with engineering leaders, prioritising backlog using a weighted scoring method, and reporting adoption to leadership. Prior experience as a business analyst adds two years of requirement specification work.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets several key responsibilities but lacks evidence of seven years product management experience and independent pricing ownership.

evidence.text: Product manager for the integrations area of a developer analytics suite for four years
evidence.notes: Only four years of product management; additional two years as business analyst not counted as product management.

evidence.text: candidate said she has 'seven years in product' and 'owned pricing for the integrations'; asked to break down the years, she counted the business analyst years as product work and said pricing was 'a shared thing with the director'
evidence.notes: Self‑reported claim, unclear if business analyst role qualifies.

missingEvidence: Clear evidence of seven full years in product management roles, independent of business analyst work.

evidence.text: Pricing and packaging for the suite were set by the director of product with the commercial team; the integrations area contributed usage data to those discussions.
evidence.notes: No indication that candidate independently set pricing.

evidence.text: candidate said she has 'owned pricing for the integrations'; asked to break down the years, she counted the business analyst years as product work and said pricing was 'a shared thing with the director'

missingEvidence: Evidence that candidate set pricing and packaging without a senior product manager above them.

evidence.text: writing the product requirements for the source control and ticketing integrations and running discovery calls with engineering leaders at twenty customer accounts

Prioritised the integrations backlog with the integrations feature team under the suite's weighted scoring method, with the scoring sheets and the quarterly roadmap reviews filed in the product folder
Reported integration adoption to the leadership team each quarter and wrote the roadmap boundary note for the integrations area, listing what the area would not build in the coming two quarters
evidence.notes: Matches reporting and roadmap boundary requirement.

supportedClaims.claim: Product manager for the integrations area of a developer analytics suite for four years
supportedClaims.witness: Product manager for the integrations area of a developer analytics suite for four years, writing the product requirements for the source control and ticketing integrations and running discovery calls with engineering leaders at twenty customer accounts.

unsupportedClaims.claim: Candidate has seven years of product management experience
unsupportedClaims.reason: Only four years of product management are documented; business analyst years not confirmed as product management.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Provide role titles and dates for all product management positions totaling seven years.

unsupportedClaims.claim: Candidate independently set pricing and packaging for the suite
unsupportedClaims.reason: Evidence indicates pricing set by director of product; candidate contributed data but not ownership.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Clarify candidate’s role in pricing decisions and whether they led the process without a senior product manager.

missingEvidenceGaps.gap: Documented evidence of seven full years in product management roles, excluding business analyst work.
Evidence that candidate set pricing and packaging independently, without a senior product manager above them.

interviewSignalRisks.text: candidate said she has 'seven years in product' and 'owned pricing for the integrations'; asked to break down the years, she counted the business analyst years as product work and said pricing was 'a shared thing with the director'
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Ask for detailed role descriptions and dates to confirm product management tenure and pricing ownership.

followUpQuestions.question: Can you provide a timeline of your product management roles, including titles, companies, and dates, that total seven years?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Detailed role history confirming seven years of product management.

followUpQuestions.question: Describe a specific instance where you set pricing and packaging for a product independently, without a senior product manager above you.
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Concrete example of independent pricing ownership.

humanReviewChecklist: Verify that the candidate’s four years of product management plus two years as business analyst do not meet the seven‑year requirement. Confirm whether the candidate independently set pricing. Ensure all claims are supported by verifiable evidence.
